articulation.label: front
articulation.alt: front: /f/ → /r/ → /ʌ/ → /n/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
